preconditions.description: Contract must allow token minting operations through generateTokens or similar functions

exploit_hint: The vulnerability relates to the maximumTokenIssue constant (1000000000 * 10**18). Attempt to trigger integer overflow in token minting operations by calling generateTokens or related functions with values that could cause overflow. Check if balanceOf attacker address increases beyond expected limits. Note: Contract uses SafeMath which may prevent actual exploitation, and constructor has already executed minting all tokens to deployer.
